=== AWS === (release notes NOT moved; 2 harness sub-pages AUDITED this scan)
aws_agentcore_releasenotes: September 2026 = 5 items (UNCHANGED from 9/23, 9/24, 9/25).
  1. Harness: Interactive shells (terminals)
  2. Harness: Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
  3. Harness: Lifecycle hooks
  4. Evaluations: TypeScript agent framework support
  5. Consent Portal for AgentCore Identity
  August 2026 = 8 items, unchanged, all previously reported.

harness-tools: AUDITED 2026-09-26. [3 FINDINGS REPORTED] See
  cache/aws_agentcore_harness_tools.txt for the literal facts. Headlines:
  * 5 tool types: remote_mcp | agentcore_gateway | agentcore_browser |
    agentcore_code_interpreter | inline_function. Builtins shell + file_operations
    ALWAYS present unless restricted (~900 tokens/request).
  * *** allowedTools does NOT affect InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand. *** Separate IAM action.
    Omitted allowedTools = ALL tools allowed (fail-open).
  * remote_mcp headers hold PLAINTEXT secrets in AWS's own example.
    Any public MCP by URL, "No Gateway required" => no policy enforcement on that path.
  * Gateway outbound auth selectable as AWS IAM | None | OAuth.
  * inline_function = CLIENT-SIDE execution; after_tool_call hook NOT reliable as an
    authorization/audit signal (AWS's own warning).
  * Web Search = a Gateway target connectorId "web-search", NOT a tool type. us-east-1.
  * tools settable at Create/Update AND per-Invoke => create-time snapshot != runtime.

harness-command-shell: AUDITED 2026-09-26. [1 FINDING REPORTED] See
  cache/aws_agentcore_harness_command_shell.txt. Headlines:
  * WebSocket bash terminal in the session microVM. wss://.../ws/shells, HARNESS arn only.
  * TWO auth paths: SigV4 => IAM InvokeAgentRuntimeCommandShell;
    *** bearer token => harness inbound authorizer, NO IAM action evaluated. ***
  * *** Neither CloudWatch nor CloudTrail logs terminal input or output. *** Connection
    metadata only. Command content structurally uncollectable from AWS-native logs.
  * Same shellId on a 2nd connection REPLACES the 1st (close 4000) = takeover primitive.
    Detached shells keep running, don't count toward the 10-active limit.
  * Does NOT state root/uid 0 (contrast InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand, which IS root).
  * Quotas: 64KB frame, 250 fps, 1hr, 10 active, 20 retained, 256KB replay.

  UNAUDITED harness subpages: harness-versioning, harness-export, harness-operations.
  *** NEW BACKLOG ITEM — PRIORITISE: harness-lifecycle-hooks, specifically
      #harness-hook-inline-functions. It was a Sept release-note item AND is the named
      weak point in the inline-function audit path. ***
aws_bedrock_changelog: newest 2026-09-21 = cross-model tokens-per-day quota. UNCHANGED.
aws_q_*: not fetched. Dead 10+ scans. RETIREMENT RECOMMENDED.
